                    ### Question
                    The hepatic clearance of a drug, mainly eliminated by metabolism, which has a high degree of hepatic extraction and a high binding to plasma proteins:

                    ### Options
                    opa. It is significantly influenced by the hepatic blood flow.
opb. It is significantly influenced by changes in the degree of plasma protein binding.
opc. It is significantly influenced both by hepatic blood flow and by changes in the degree of plasma protein binding.
opd. It will not be influenced by the hepatic blood flow or by changes in the degree of binding to plasma proteins.
ope. It will depend on the absolute bioavailability of the drug.
